"""Main: exact compiled-source reconciliation; no compilation or GPU work."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012')
P = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v1'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
OLD = B / 'xe-v0143-nonfinite-free-qualification-root-v4/record.json'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('integrated_reuse_owner', O)
owner_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(owner_module)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def pin(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=owner_module.sha(p))

def closed(r):
    assert r['passed'] and r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error')
    assert all(owner_module.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
               for c in r['commands'])

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[],
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, freshly_built_at_selected_commit=False,
             proof_kind='compiled-source-closure-equivalent reuse of existing historical build',
             controller=pin(Path(__file__)), original_build=pin(OLD), whole_wall_seconds=180)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = owner_module.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    start = time.monotonic()
    def run(label, argv):
        remaining = 180 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert remaining > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=min(45, remaining), cpu=60,
            rss_cap=4 << 30, text_cap=16 << 20, file_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert owner_module.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
        return so.read_text()
    try:
        old = json.loads(OLD.read_text())
        closed(old)
        assert owner_module.sha(OLD) == '8ce60db2f5d18b02d3d061f70c7a027b983083fbae8cab9c1ca376bf1f7fe1d2'
        assert not old['gpu_executed'] and not old['model_executed']
        assert old['source_tree'] == str(W)
        revision = run('selected-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip()
        assert revision == '0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035'
        assert not run('selected-clean-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1']).strip()
        production = json.loads((P / 'production-source-pins.json').read_text())['source_pins']['xe']
        assert len(production) == len(old['source_pins']) == 460
        assert set(production) == set(old['source_pins'])
        changes = {name: dict(old=old['source_pins'][name], current=digest)
                   for name, digest in production.items() if old['source_pins'][name] != digest}
        changed = 'serve/test_session_save_retry.py'
        assert changes == {changed: dict(old='8da3a32386d10d8643484fbde3b5b59c399aeff736e7486273466325975a770a',
                                          current='15917adc5b5e391640af016ad7c7bbdb3e756a0ac6c97a5d8be1887ede6e55de')}
        for name, digest in production.items():
            assert owner_module.sha(W / name) == digest
        assert set(old['build_recipe']) == {'CMakeCache.txt', 'compile_commands.json', 'BUILD.json'}
        for recipe in old['build_recipe'].values():
            assert owner_module.sha(recipe['path']) == recipe['sha256']
        commands = json.loads(Path(old['build_recipe']['compile_commands.json']['path']).read_text())
        assert commands and all(changed not in json.dumps(command) for command in commands)
        assert changed not in old['ninja_compile_link_recipe']
        recipe = run('actual-ninja-command-recipe', next(c['argv'] for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'ninja-recipe'))
        # -C in a tool command does not emit a progress prefix on this Ninja version.
        assert recipe == old['ninja_compile_link_recipe']
        dependencies = run('actual-ninja-dependencies', ['/usr/bin/ninja', '-C', str(W / 'build/free'), '-t', 'deps'])
        assert changed not in dependencies and dependencies.strip()
        assert all('test_session_save_retry' not in item['command'] for item in commands)
        original_targets = next(c['argv'] for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'compile-full')
        assert 'strata' in original_targets and all('python' not in part.lower() for part in original_targets)
        compiler_receipt = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-root-v5/record.json'
        assert owner_module.sha(compiler_receipt) == old['compiler_receipt_sha256'] == '3f1c3741f6b09b78377064a2b993b558a52b1b95ff30f5eb016ea8c6342d9e3a'
        compiler_record = json.loads(compiler_receipt.read_text())
        closed(compiler_record)
        compiler = compiler_record['installed_files']['bin/clang++']
        assert owner_module.sha(compiler['path']) == compiler['sha256']
        compiler_argv = next(c['argv'] for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'compiler-version')
        assert compiler_argv == [compiler['path'], '--version']
        assert run('actual-compiler-version', compiler_argv) == old['compiler_version']
        dependency_argv = next(c['argv'] for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'ggml-head')
        assert run('actual-dependency-head', dependency_argv).strip() == '3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d'
        assert old['command_evidence']['ggml-head']['stdout'].strip() == '3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d'
        dependency_status = next(c['argv'] for c in old['commands'] if c['label'] == 'ggml-status')
        assert not run('actual-dependency-status', dependency_status).strip()
        binary = old['binary']
        assert binary['sha256'] == 'ed65b895b7373669d1e93e4adf9082fa2cddf109266e0255fc6a5b72ede5f27a'
        assert owner_module.sha(binary['path']) == binary['sha256']
        # This is the exact changed noncompiled file, tested separately from binary reuse.
        save_test = run('changed-save-retry-current-tests', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', '-v',
                                                           'serve.test_session_save_retry'])
        assert owner_module.sha(W / changed) == production[changed]
        r.update(selected_revision=revision, historical_source_base=old['source_base'],
                 source_pins=production, binary=binary, source_delta=changes,
                 compiled_source_exclusion=dict(path=changed, compile_commands_absent=True,
                     ninja_compile_link_recipe_absent=True, actual_ninja_dependencies_absent=True,
                     build_targets_do_not_run_python=True, all_other_459_source_bytes_identical=True),
                 original_build_recipe=old['build_recipe'], original_build_targets=original_targets,
                 original_compiler_receipt_sha256=old['compiler_receipt_sha256'],
                 actual_compiler=compiler, actual_compiler_build=pin(compiler_receipt),
                 actual_dependency_revision='3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d',
                 effective_compile_link_flags_evidence=old['build_recipe'],
                 original_compiler_version=old['compiler_version'],
                 original_dependency_evidence=old['command_evidence']['ggml-head'],
                 actual_ninja_recipe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(recipe.encode()).hexdigest(),
                 actual_ninja_dependency_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dependencies.encode()).hexdigest(),
                 inference_executable_built=True, compiler_provider='source-llvm-7.1.1',
                 backend='xe', strata_enable_sycl=False,
                 limitations=['No fresh build, no model/GPU execution, no performance/full-context claim',
                     'Original v4 build status and historical dirty-source/base provenance remain unchanged'])
        assert not run('selected-final-clean-status', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1']).strip()
        assert owner_module.sha(OLD) == r['original_build']['sha256']
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=owner_module.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'proof_kind')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
